name: schema_compare
description:
Compares the column schema of two local CSV, JSON, JSONL, or SQLite sources. Returns columns unique to each side, shared columns, and type differences without returning data rows.
Use when: checking whether two exports, datasets, or SQLite tables are compatible before migration or transformation.
Scope: local filesystem only. Read-only.
Not for: comparing row values, moving data, or querying remote databases.

left_path.description: First local data file or SQLite database.

right_path.description: Second local data file or SQLite database.

left_table.description: Required when left_path is SQLite and has more than one table.

right_table.description: Required when right_path is SQLite and has more than one table.
